description: This file defines the interface 'TypedDataInterface' for typed data objects in Drupal, including method signatures for data manipulation, validation, and context management.

classes.name: TypedDataInterface
classes.description: Interface for typed data objects in Drupal, specifying methods for data handling, validation, and context management.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Constructs a TypedData object given its definition and context.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the data value with optional notification.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the data.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies the default value with optional notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property or item.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root of the typed data tree.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path relative to the root.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the context of a property or item via a parent.
